title: The swarm's research tree
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Blood Weavers
items.desc: These nanites gather at wounds, knitting flesh and sealing cuts with a web of fibers.

items.name: Bladebind
items.desc: A thin layer of nanites sharpens edges and clings to them in battle, ensuring your strikes hit true.

items.name: Cutting Edge
items.desc: A thin layer of nanites coats your blades, making every swing sharper and deadlier.

items.name: Blade Swarm
items.desc: A cloud of nanites sharpens your weapon's edge, making every strike leave a mark.

items.name: Edge Swarm
items.desc: A thin film of nanites along your weapon's edge. They sharpen every swing, making even a dull blade feel new.

items.name: Crusader's Skin
items.desc: A hidden layer of nanites that stiffens to guard against blows, worn by those who face the harshest battles. It was said to be perfected in Shellhaven by a knight who never knew a serious wound.

items.name: Nerve Fingers
items.desc: The weave anticipates blows, pulling you away from danger. Like a spider sensing the slightest vibration.

items.name: Sharp Edge
items.desc: A thin layer of nanites that coats your weapons, sharpening edges and ensuring every strike is lethal.

items.name: Whetstone Veil
items.desc: A thin film of nanites along your blades that sharpens them with every strike.

items.name: Edge Eels
items.desc: A slick of nanites that coat your blade like eels, sharpening and honing it with each swing.

items.name: Firebeetles
items.desc: These tiny mites hitch a ride on your blade, setting foes ablaze with each strike. They're drawn to the heat of battle.

items.name: Boosters
items.desc: A cluster of nanites that pushes your muscles beyond their limits. They burn through qi faster than you, but it lets you strike harder and faster.

items.name: Glowing Guides
items.desc: A few motes drift ahead, lighting the way through the dark with a soft glow. They show the path, but cannot fight.

items.name: Echo Web
items.desc: Threads of silence that hum with life's secrets, guiding you through the unseen.

items.name: Rock Tasters
items.desc: They crawl through stone and soil, tasting for ores and veins, guiding your picks to the richest seams.

items.name: Dead Men's Gold
items.desc: They whisper tales of lost graves and hoarded treasures, guiding you to the bones that gleam with forgotten riches.

items.name: Steady Hands
items.desc: They smooth your tremors, letting you shape the finest metal or weave the finest thread. Masters of delicate crafts can now pass their prime without losing a touch.

items.name: Nanite Fingers
items.desc: Each finger wields tools too small to see, crafting with a precision that no human hand could match.

items.name: Runescarvers
items.desc: These tiny workers cut runes and draw lines with uncanny precision, turning your fingers into master artisans.

items.name: Nano Forge
items.desc: A pocket factory that builds anything from the smallest part to the largest structure, crafting wonders with molecules and minerals alike.

items.name: Breath Takers
items.desc: Tiny machines that siphon thin qi from the air, feeding it directly to the cultivator's body. They make it easier to sustain meditation in sparse environments.

items.name: Clean Sweep
items.desc: Tiny workers that scrub your qi pathways clean, making your meditations and cleansings faster and more efficient.

items.name: Mind Relay
items.desc: These tiny machines carry thoughts farther than your mind alone. During meditation, your research progresses as if you were focused for twice the time.

items.name: Economy Swarm
items.desc: They learn to run on less: everything that uses qi costs less to keep running.

items.name: Celestial Bridge
items.desc: A design meant to connect the mortal to the divine, though it remains a bridge stillborn. It promises a step closer to the heavens, but the gap remains vast.

items.name: Mind Splitter
items.desc: This design allows a cultivator to meditate while still engaging in other tasks. It's like having an assistant in your mind that can focus on qi refinement while you attend to the world.

items.name: Triple Mind
items.desc: Three thoughts at once. Meditation can split three ways.

items.name: Parallel Sprint
items.desc: The swarm hums even when you rest, working at half speed to never let your research or cleansing lag behind.

items.name: Parallel Thread
items.desc: The swarm learns to work on its own, keeping up research and cleansing at a quarter pace while you focus elsewhere.

items.name: Half Pace
items.desc: The swarm hums in the background, running at half-speed even when you're not meditating. Research and cleansing progress constantly, like a stream that never stops flowing.

items.name: Mental Web
items.desc: A delicate mesh woven into the brain's own pathways. It sharpens reflexes and steadies the hand, like an invisible guide.

items.name: Faster Thoughts
items.desc: These implants let your nerves fire ahead of your thoughts, making your movements quicker and reflexes sharper.

items.name: Qi Cache
items.desc: Cells that hoard qi like a camel hoards water, keeping you steady in lean times.

items.name: Echo Weave
items.desc: A fabric of qi threads spun deep in the mind, ensuring every skill and every lesson is remembered and retained without fail.

items.name: Meshweave
items.desc: Woven into the flesh, the mesh holds armor in place and absorbs blows, a silent guard under the skin.

items.name: Steel Tendons
items.desc: Carbon wires replace your weakest tendons, holding your muscles tighter and tougher. They never break, no matter how hard you fight.

items.name: Edge Mites
items.desc: These tiny creatures form a nearly invisible film along the edges of your weapons, sharpening and hardening them each time you swing.

items.name: Heart Cage
items.desc: A lattice of fine wires encases the heart, deflecting blows that would otherwise be fatal. It's a second line of defense, letting even the most battered of warriors continue fighting.

items.name: Guardian Cage
items.desc: A lattice of fine wire encircles the heart, deflecting blows before they strike. It hums softly when danger is near.

items.name: Muscle Pushers
items.desc: These nanites push your muscles past their limits, but it costs them more than it costs you.

items.name: Second Spine
items.desc: Wires that fire before your mind does, letting you dodge before danger comes. A master's reflexes in the body of a novice.

items.name: Mind Engine
items.desc: A silicon brain behind the eyes, it thinks faster than you can: research and cleansing fly past.

items.name: Iron Shell
items.desc: A metal frame that wraps around your bones. It moves with you but drains qi.

items.name: Joint Servos
items.desc: Servos at each joint make your limbs stronger and faster, but they hum like a mill when you move.

items.name: Mirrored Plates
items.desc: A suit of armor woven from star iron and mirror silver, deflecting and absorbing blows. Each plate is imbued with light, reflecting enemies' attacks back at them.

items.name: Life Heart
items.desc: A reactor that burns qi to power the frame, turning every cell into a lantern. It keeps you going when you're spent, and heals you faster than any apothecary.

items.name: Life Core
items.desc: A heart of nanites that burns qi to mend and shield, reducing the cost of all qi-based abilities. It's the heart of power armour, a living machine that serves and sustains its wearer.
